{{Current events|year=2021|month=01|day=15|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**[[Taliban insurgency]]; [[2021 Afghanistan attacks]]
***At least nine security personnel are killed in [[Kunduz Province|Kunduz]], near the border with [[Tajikistan]], when [[Taliban]] [[insurgent]]s simultaneously attack two [[security checkpoint|checkpoints]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2021/01/15/Taliban-kills-at-least-nine-Afghan-security-personnel-Officials- (Al Arabiya English)]
*[[Mali War]]
**An [[Egypt]]ian [[United Nations|UN]] [[United Nations peacekeeping|peacekeeper]] is killed and another wounded after a [[bomb]] planted by [[jihadism|jihadists]] detonates under a truck that was part of a UN logistics convoy. [https://news.un.org/en/story/2021/01/1082332 (UN News)]
*[[Central African Republic Civil War]]
**A [[Burundi]]an [[United Nations|UN]] [[United Nations peacekeeping|peacekeeper]] is killed in a rebel ambush near [[Grimari]] in [[Ouaka]], [[Central African Republic]], acccording to [[MINUSCA]]. Two [[Bangladesh]]i peacekeepers are also wounded in the attack. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210116-un-peacekeeper-killed-in-central-african-republic (France 24)]

'''Business and economy'''
*Canadian [[convenience store]] chain [[Alimentation Couche-Tard]] withdraws its bid to [[Takeover|take over]] the French retailer [[Carrefour]], after the [[French government]] expressed its intent to veto the [[Euro|€]]16 billion ([[United States dollar|US$]]19.5 billion) deal. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/business/2051959/canadian-firm-pulls-out-of-carrefour-takeover-after-france-insists-no (AFP via ''Bangkok Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Sulawesi earthquake]]
**A [[Moment magnitude scale|magnitude]] 6.2 [[list of earthquakes in Indonesia|earthquake]] strikes the [[Majene Regency]] in [[West Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]], killing at least 42 people and wounding more than 820 others. It was preceded by a [[foreshock]] measuring 5.7 a few hours before. [https://www.reuters.com/article/APAC/idUSKBN29K00X?il=0 (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**The number of [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] worldwide surpasses two million. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/15/this-is-not-a-game-two-million-people-dead-from-covid-19 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maine]]
******[[Governor of Maine|Governor]] [[Janet Mills]] receives her first dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://bangordailynews.com/2021/01/15/politics/janet-mills-receives-1st-dose-of-coronavirus-vaccine/ (''Bangor Daily News'')]
*****[[President-elect of the United States|President-elect]] [[Joe Biden]] is expected to deploy the [[United States National Guard]] and [[Federal Emergency Management Agency|FEMA]] resources to distribute vaccines across the [[United States]] when he takes office. He also says that he will invoke the [[Defense Production Act of 1950|Defense Production Act]] to produce vaccines. [https://thewest.com.au/politics/biden-vows-to-speed-covid-vaccine-rollout-ng-s-2045596 (''The West Australian'')] [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/biden-covid-vaccine-national-guard-fema-b1788159.html (''The Independent'')] 
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Illinois]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Illinois]] reports their first case of a more contagious variant of [[SARS-CoV-2]] in a person who traveled to the [[United Kingdom]] and the [[Middle East]] and was later diagnosed with COVID-19. [https://www.chicagotribune.com/coronavirus/ct-coronavirus-illinois-pritzker-variant-20210115-e56uq32y4ffb3itf3wtuirhyaq-story.html?outputType=amp (''Chicago Tribune'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oregon]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
*****[[Oregon]] reports their first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 that originated from the [[United Kingdom]] in a man from [[Multnomah County, Oregon|Multnomah County]] with no travel history. [https://www.kgw.com/article/news/health/coronavirus/vaccine/oregon-detects-1st-case-of-covid-19-variant-discovered-in-the-uk/283-2ccffc99-cbe6-4a3c-b7df-33508152d9ac (KGW-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Utah]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
*****[[Utah]] reports their first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 that originated from the [[United Kingdom]] in a man from [[Salt Lake County, Utah|Salt Lake County]] with no travel history who tested positive last month. [https://www.standard.net/news/utah-reports-first-case-of-united-kingdom-covid-19-variant/article_776c8b98-8ac7-5201-8285-d278e3769201.html (''The Standard-Examiner'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin]]
*****[[Governor of Wisconsin|Governor]] [[Tony Evers]] announces that the [[Wisconsin|state]] will extend its [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]] for 60 days. [https://www.wsaw.com/2021/01/15/gov-evers-extends-statewide-mask-mandate/ (WSAW-TV)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****[[Mexico]] reports a record 21,366 new confirmed cases, bringing the total of confirmed cases to 1.61 million. [https://apnews.com/article/pandemics-mexico-coronavirus-pandemic-mexico-city-f475823ee4ffa4cd69c1d41f0a92ba16 (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uttarakhand]], Variant of Concern 202012/01
*****[[Uttarakhand]] reports their first case of a new variant of SARS-CoV-2 in a 44-year old man who was in close contact with people who travelled to the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/dehradun-news/uttarakhand-confirms-first-case-of-uk-covid-19-variant-101610705412526.html (Hindustan Times)]  
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 12,818 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, including 3,095 in [[West Java]], bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 882,418. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5335376/alert-jabar-kasus-corona-tembus-3-ribu-lewati-dki (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[China]] reports 144 new cases, the majority in [[Hebei]] and [[Heilongjiang]] [[provinces of China|provinces]]. This is the highest number of daily cases in the past 10 months and brings the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 87,988. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/china-reports-most-daily-covid-19-cases-in-over-10-months (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] extends their [[Malaysian movement control order|movement control order]] to [[Kelantan]] beginning at midnight as COVID-19 cases continue to rise. [https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/nation/2021/01/15/kelantan-now-sixth-state-under-mco (Free Malaysia Today)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] extends until January 31 its travel ban on more than 30 countries and territories where cases of [[Variants of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2 variants]] have been reported. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1793091/world (''Arab News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] surpasses two million cases of [[Coronavirus disease|COVID-19]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210115-german-virus-cases-top-2-million-as-merkel-urges-tougher-shutdown (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports a record 159 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 8,543. [https://www.publico.pt/2021/01/15/sociedade/noticia/covid19-portugal-regista-novo-maximo-mortes-159-ha-10663-infectados-1946470 (PÚBLICO)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] reports a record 40,197 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the total number of confirmed cases to 2,252,164. [https://www.elmundo.es/ciencia-y-salud/salud/2021/01/15/6001bf94fdddff452c8b4622.html (''El Mundo'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sweden]]
****[[Monarchy of Sweden|King of Sweden]] [[Carl XVI Gustaf]] receives his first dose of the COVID-19 vaccine. [https://www.kungahuset.se/kungafamiljen/aktuellahandelser/aretsaktuellt/kungaparetvaccinerademotcovid19.5.5e7d48041768421df9c14385.html (Kungahuset)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] announces the closure of all [[Transport corridor|travel corridors]] beginning January 18 at 4:00 am [[Greenwich Mean Time|GMT]]. He also announces that all travellers must have proof of a negative [[COVID-19 testing|COVID-19 test]] from the previous 72 hours and quarantine for 10 days upon arrival, unless they test negative after five days. [https://www.itv.com/goodmorningbritain/articles/covid-travel-corridors-end-when-4-am-monday-18-january-boris-johnson-details (ITV)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile]]
****The Chilean government reports 4,471 new cases, the highest daily total since June. A potential new lockdown in the [[Santiago Metropolitan Region]] is under evaluation according to the Ministry of Health. [https://www.adnradio.cl/nacional/2021/01/15/volvera-toda-la-rm-a-cuarentena-ministro-paris-no-descarto-el-retroceso-debido-al-aumento-de-casos-de-covid-19.html (''ADN Radio'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Paraguay]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Paraguay]] approves the emergency use of Russia's [[Gam-COVID-Vac|Sputnik V]] [[vaccine]], becoming the fourth South American country to approve the use of the vaccine against COVID-19, after Argentina, Bolivia and Venezuela. Supply of the vaccine will be facilitated by the [[Russian Direct Investment Fund]]. [https://www.prnewswire.co.uk/news-releases/the-russian-direct-investment-fund-sputnik-v-vaccine-approved-in-paraguay-823381946.html (PRNewswire)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Tunisia]]
***[[Tunisia]] reports a record 4,170 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours as the country enters a four-day [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] and also closes all schools until January 24 in order to reduce the spread of COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-tunisia/tunisia-reports-daily-coronavirus-record-of-4170-cases-idUSKBN29K2KB (Reuters)]
*[[2020–21 H5N8 outbreak]]
**Authorities in [[Namibia]] suspend the importation and transit of [[poultry]] from European countries where an outbreak of the [[Influenza A virus subtype H5N8|Avian influenza subtype H5N8]] has been reported. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2021-01/15/c_139670474.htm (Xinhua)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[Russia]] says that it will withdraw from the [[Treaty on Open Skies]], following the U.S. withdrawal from the treaty last year. The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] says that the U.S. withdrawal has "significantly upended the balance of interests of signatory states". [https://apnews.com/article/military-facilities-moscow-europe-russia-e58019b80ae95e12007265aedfac229b (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Pan Am Flight 103]]
**The family of [[Abdelbaset al-Megrahi]], the [[Lockerbie]] bomber, loses a posthumous appeal at a top Scottish court against his conviction. Al-Megrahi was the [[Pan Am Flight 103 bombing trial|only person convicted]] for the [[terrorism in the United Kingdom|terrorist]] attack, whereas his family say that he was the victim of a "[[miscarriage of justice]]". [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-scotland-south-scotland-55663299 (BBC)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Ugandan general election]]
**Opposition activist [[Bobi Wine]] claims victory in the presidential election, despite early results giving incumbent [[President of Uganda|President]] [[Yoweri Museveni]] a wide lead, and calls the results "a joke". [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20210115-bobi-wine-claims-victory-as-uganda-awaits-final-election-results?ref=re (France 24)]
**Bobi Wine [[Twitter|tweets]] that [[Uganda People's Defence Force|the military]] has "taken control" of his home and placed him under [[house arrest]], just hours after claiming victory in the disputed election. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/15/uganda-opposition-leader-bobi-wine-says-military-enters-home (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Presidential transition of Joe Biden]]
**[[Vice President of the United States|United States Vice President]] [[Mike Pence]] congratulates incoming Vice President [[Kamala Harris]], 73 days after the [[2020 United States presidential election|presidential election]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2021/01/15/pence-congratulates-harris-inauguration-459702 (Politico)] [https://apnews.com/article/joe-biden-donald-trump-politics-michael-pence-kamala-harris-9cf431138cceeda9f6f7104e0fa20487 (AP)]
*[[Netherlands child welfare fraud scandal]]
**The [[third Rutte cabinet]] of [[the Netherlands]] falls after [[negotiation]]s regarding the childcare allowance scandal. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-55674146 (BBC)]
*[[2021 Palestinian general election]]
**[[President of the State of Palestine|President]] [[Mahmoud Abbas]] announces that the legislative elections will be held on May 22, while the presidential elections will be held on July 31. These are the first elections in the [[State of Palestine]] since [[2006 Palestinian legislative election|2006]]. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1793536/middle-east (AFP via ''Arab News'')]
*The [[Lao People's Revolutionary Party]] elects [[Prime Minister of Laos|Prime Minister]] [[Thongloun Sisoulith]] as its new [[General Secretary of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party|General Secretary]], replacing retiring chief [[Bounnhang Vorachit]]. Sisoulith was elected for a five-year term as leader of the [[Central Committee of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party]], the top post in the country, and part of the country's [[Politburo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-laos-politics/laos-communist-party-names-pm-thongloun-as-new-leader-idUSKBN29K0YU (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on association football]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
**[[FC Barcelona]] postpones its [[2021 FC Barcelona presidential election|presidential election]] originally scheduled for January 24, following an increase in COVID-19 cases in [[Catalonia]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/sports/soccer/barcelona-delays-presidential-elections-because-of-pandemic/2021/01/15/194ba592-5742-11eb-acc5-92d2819a1ccb_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
